delegates.ConstantFoldBinaryOpOperands: foldOrCommuteConstant with both operands constant, IS.foldOrCommuteConstant.L582: the constant folder, not modelled
delegates.simplifyAndOrOfCmps: and/or of two icmps, looking through casts of one opcode from one type: another family's fold (simplifyAndOfICmps, simplifyOrOfICmps), not modelled here; the model hands over only where both operands are icmps after the look-through
delegates.simplifyAssociativeBinOp: recursive calls to simplifyBinOp with MaxRecurse - 1; hands over only where MaxRecurse isn't 0 and an operand has the same opcode
delegates.expandCommutativeBinOp: recursive calls to simplifyBinOp with MaxRecurse - 1; hands over only where MaxRecurse isn't 0 and an operand has the opcode it distributes over
delegates.threadBinOpOverSelect: recursive calls to simplifyBinOp with MaxRecurse - 1; hands over only where MaxRecurse isn't 0 and an operand is a select
delegates.threadBinOpOverPHI: recursive calls to simplifyBinOp with MaxRecurse - 1 over a phi's incoming values; a phi is an opaque Term (Term.var), so it hands over where MaxRecurse isn't 0 and an operand is opaque
delegates.simplifyByDomEq: shared with sub, udiv, sdiv, urem and srem, and its sites (IS.simplifyByDomEq.L727, L736) aren't this family's; it answers only at MaxRecurse == RecursionLimit, and only where isImpliedByDomCondition says Op0 == Op1, which Logic.Ext.domEq answers; with no Ext the model hands over at the top level
delegates.isCheckForZeroAndMulWithOverflow: the overflow bit isn't a Term (see unproved); hands over where an operand is opaque and the other an icmp of the right predicate against 0
delegates.simplifyWithOpReplaced: with no Logic.Ext, as onInst has it, the model hands over where Op0 is an equality icmp or trunc nuw to i1; with an Ext, its answer is a parameter, see rests_on
delegates.isImpliedCondition: with LHSIsTrue=false, in simplifyOrInst on i1: with no Logic.Ext, as onInst has it, the model hands over; with an Ext, see rests_on

unproved.IS.simplifyAndCommutative.L2040: the overflow bit of llvm.umul.with.overflow or llvm.smul.with.overflow, an extractvalue of the call's aggregate, isn't a Term: no Term is an aggregate or an extractvalue.
